name: Worldforged Loch Modan pickups sit at or above ground and open (#10219)
contract: #10219 reported Loch Modan Worldforged items spawning underground. An audit of all Loch Modan spawns from the 2026_09_23_05 realm-map pass against calibrated Eastern Kingdoms terrain heights and VMaps found six active pickups still 0.515 to 1.638 yd under terrain: 6940384 (Muck Coated Pendant, 97118, -1.638 yd), 6940402 (Stolen Shipment, 97121, -1.621 yd), 6940507 (Tattered Cloth Roll, 95533, -1.261 yd), 6941158 (Special Brewing Gear, 518319, -1.261 yd), 6941035 (Wreckage Piece, 95531, -0.692 yd), and 6940726 (Open Wound, 95532, -0.515 yd).

rev_20261126_10219_worldforged_loch_modan_underground.sql restores the five realm-dump spots (6901492, 6901495 inside Animalden.wmo, 6903342, 6901047 on Gyrocopter.m2, 6901048) and applies the Loch Modan LootCollector coordinate (-5268.45, -4132.88, 335.382) to 6941158. Expected: all six stand at their restored coordinates with spawn_ground_gap >= -0.3 yd (all six fail pre-fix), the five dry pickups are not submerged (6940384 Drowned Pendant rests on the Loch bed), and a player at 6941158 opens it for loot.
